title: harveyai/harvey-labs: a public benchmark for legal agents
friendlyTitle: Harvey LAB tests how well AI agents handle legal work
summary: Harvey LAB provides realistic legal tasks, documents, rubrics and an execution harness for evaluating agents that support legal work. The trending repository recently added a 250-task enterprise-search benchmark and currently shows about 780 stars.
friendlySummary: This open-source project gives AI agents realistic legal tasks and a clear way to score their work.
whyItMatters: Legal-technology teams can compare agents on repeatable assignments, inspect detailed scoring and add tasks that reflect their own workflows. Benchmark success does not replace lawyer review, confidentiality controls or jurisdiction-specific validation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Legal teams can compare tools before using them on real matters. A qualified lawyer must still check every important result.
